title: "Supplemental table and extended data for the manuscript"

## Load Packages

Load necessary R packages for data manipulation, visualization, and GO analysis.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pacman::p_load(readxl, gt, patchwork, install = FALSE)
source(here("custom_func/p_value_label.R"))
source(here("custom_func/go_term_weights.R"))

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

## Set the top number

```{r}
top_n <- 1000
```

## Load Data

### GO enrichment results

Read the previously saved GO enrichment results for top CpG sites.

```{r}
#| label: load-results
#| message: false

all_GO_results <- read_rds(here(glue("pathway_analysis/02_gene_ontology/output/top{top_n}_all_GO_results.rds"))) |>
  mutate(condition = factor(
    condition, 
    levels = c("normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev")
  ))


glimpse(all_GO_results)
```

### Function categorization

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false

function_categorization <- 
  # read_csv(here(glue::glue("pathway_analysis/04_function_categorization/output/top{top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms_cat_modified.csv"))) |>
  read_excel(
    # here::here("data", glue::glue("top{top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms_cat.xlsx")),
    # here(glue("data/publicly_available/top{top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms_cat.xlsx")),
    here(glue("pathway_analysis/04_function_categorization/output/top{top_n}_condition_specific_GO_terms_auto_cat.xlsx")),
    # sheet = "func_cat",
  ) |>
mutate(condition = fct_relevel(condition, "normal2mci", "stable_mci", "normal2incid", "mci2incid", "prev")) #|>
  # Remove function_category column
  # select(-function_category) |>
  # Rename function_category to function_category
  # rename(function_category = function_category)

glimpse(function_categorization)
```

## Significant GO terms

Parent terms whose genes are identical to those of a significant child term are dropped (Rule 1, from `06_go_hierarchy/03_go_term_weights.qmd`), as in `03_transition_specific_GO_terms`.

```{r}
significant_GO_terms <- all_GO_results |>
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05, !ID %in% read_go_duplicate_parents(top_n)$parent)

glimpse(significant_GO_terms)
```

## Condition-specific GO terms

```{r}
condition_specific_GO_terms <- significant_GO_terms |>
  add_count(ID, name = "n_condition") |>
  mutate(condition_specific = if_else(n_condition == 1, "Yes", "No"))

glimpse(condition_specific_GO_terms)
```

## Frequency of shared GO terms

```{r}
condition_specific_GO_terms |>
  group_by(n_condition) |>
  summarise(n_GO = n_distinct(ID)) |>
  rename(n_shared_condition = n_condition) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Frequency of shared GO terms")
```


## Attach function categorization to GO enrichment results

```{r}
condition_specific_GO_terms_with_category <- condition_specific_GO_terms |>
  left_join(select(function_categorization, ID, condition, function_category), by = c("ID", "condition"))

glimpse(condition_specific_GO_terms_with_category)
```

## Create tables

### Intialize a list to store the tables

```{r}
tbl_list <- list()
```

### Create a function to create the tables

```{r}
#| label: create-table-function


create_table <- function(condition, function_category_filter = NULL) {
  # Filter and select relevant columns
  formatted_data <- condition_specific_GO_terms_with_category |>  
    filter(condition == .env$condition, condition_specific == "Yes") |>
    filter(if (!is.null(function_category_filter)) function_category %in% function_category_filter else TRUE) |>
    select(ID, Description, p.adjust, function_category) |>
    arrange(function_category, p.adjust)
    
  # Create and format GT table
  formatted_data |>
    gt() |>
    # Adjusted P in the house style (custom_func/p_value_label.R): three significant
    # figures, a decimal at P >= 0.01 and scientific notation below
    fmt(columns = p.adjust, fns = format_p_value) |>
    # Style headers and labels
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = list(
        cells_column_labels(),
        cells_title()
      )
    ) |>
    # Customize column labels  
    cols_label(
      ID = "GO ID",
      Description = "Description", 
      p.adjust = md("Adjusted *P*"),
      function_category = "Function Category"
    ) |>
    # Add title and footnotes
    tab_header(
      title = paste0(condition, "-specific GO terms")
    ) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = "Fisher one-sided test adjusted by BH method",
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = p.adjust)
    )
}


```

### Normal2MCI-1

```{r}
tbl_list$normal2mci_1 <- create_table("normal2mci", function_category_filter = c("Immune Response", "Synaptic Function and Organization", "Extracellular Matrix Organization"))

```

## Save the tables

```{r}
#| label: save-tables

# Extended data

```
